mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_log (admin_id, target_request_id, action, reason) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{targetRequestId}, #{action}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS matching_id, ur.title AS request_title, h.name AS helper_name, m.status AS matching_status, m.created_at AS created_at FROM matching m JOIN user_request ur ON m.request_id = ur.id JOIN helper h ON m.helper_id = h.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
